name: Bitcoin Mission
rootCause: Bitcoin Mission was exploited on Arbitrum One in April 2025, losing approximately $1.3 million due to improper access control in the OverPaper function of the Card Factory contract. The attacker was able to withdraw funds repeatedly across hundreds of transactions. The Card Factory contract's OverPaper function lacked strict caller validation, allowing unauthorized accounts to withdraw protocol funds. No role-based restriction prevented repeated withdrawals.
